Hero.s1heading: Research smarter. Learn better. Build academic skills.
Hero.s1body: Schobot builds academic technology for researchers, students and lifelong learners — from AI-assisted research to structured learning and training.
Hero.s2heading: Turn scanned documents into searchable knowledge.
Hero.s2body: Extract Arabic and English text, preserve structure and integrate clean data into your workflows.
Hero.s3heading: Convert Arabic audio and video into editable text.
Hero.s3body: Build transcription, call analytics, media indexing and conversational applications with speech recognition.
Hero.s4heading: Give Arabic text a clear, natural voice.
Hero.s4body: Generate expressive audio for accessibility, education, customer service and media experiences.

About.heading: Technology designed around academic work.
About.body1: Schobot is an academic technology company creating products that help people discover knowledge, work with research materials and develop practical academic skills.
About.body2: Our product ecosystem covers complementary parts of the academic journey, from AI-assisted research to learning, training and knowledge organization.

Technologies.heading: Explore an AI stack made for Arabic content.
Technologies.body: Three technology families can be used independently or combined into larger automation workflows.
Technologies.t1subheading: Make speech content searchable and actionable.
Technologies.t1body: Use fast speech recognition and text-to-speech components for transcription, media workflows, call analytics and voice-driven interfaces.
Technologies.t2body: Convert scanned Arabic and English documents into editable, searchable and structured information suitable for downstream business systems.
Technologies.t3subheading: Understand the meaning inside Arabic text.
Technologies.t3body: Use text classification, named-entity recognition, diacritization and enrichment tools to build better search, automation and content experiences.

Products.heading: A growing product ecosystem for research, learning and academic growth.
